claim: P1 engineering non-inferiority for one pre-bound three-node HYLE Graph Invocation against the exact same three HYLE Compute PreparedOperations submitted as a direct sequence, under the same tensor, queue, arithmetic and synchronous completion contract

configuration.role: same-product immediate lower abstraction tier, not an external SOTA peer
configuration.route: the exact HYLE-native PreparedOperation and OperationInvocation implementations fixed by the Compute v5 candidate
configuration.semantic_delta: the direct caller owns two equivalent preallocated intermediate Buffers and manually submits and waits for three operations; Graph owns the equivalent per-Invocation Mem lifetime workspace, fixed binding mask and immutable three-node plan

ownership_topology.candidate: One immutable shared Executable retains the three PreparedOperations; one exclusive pre-bound Invocation owns its Mem lifetime workspace and submits the fixed plan with caller-owned input, weight and output TensorViews
ownership_topology.peer: The same process retains the same three PreparedOperation kinds and separate OperationInvocations; the caller owns two equivalent preallocated intermediate Buffers plus its output Buffer and submits the operations in the same dependency order
ownership_topology.equivalence: Both sides use separately but identically initialized 64-byte-aligned storage, the same Context and Queue, the same descriptions and HYLE-native SIMD arithmetic routes, one wait after each synchronous operation and one terminal success result; construction, preparation, allocation, binding, warmup and first touch are outside measurement, while route allocation order is crossed independently from execution order

material_contribution.denominator: one decode-shaped RMSNorm, transpose-view MatMul and packed SiLU GatedActivation invocation
material_contribution.derivation: The five reviewed inference sources all retain this normalization, projection and gated-activation composition; reduced but nontrivial dimensions keep fixed Graph bookkeeping visible instead of hiding it under a large matrix

workloads.semantic_contract: Execute one warmed allocation-free float32 RMSNorm over [1,256] with a [256] weight, one [1,256] by logical [256,1024] transpose-view MatMul, and one packed SiLU GatedActivation to [1,512], returning after the third synchronous Completion

input.distribution: deterministic finite signed float32 activation and projection weights plus positive RMSNorm weights, initialized and first-touched outside measurement

workloads.setup: Context, Queue, descriptions, Buffers, PreparedOperations, logical Graph, compile, Invocation creation, binding and one correctness-checked warm execution occur before nanobench
charged_phases: three public OperationInvocation submissions using the fixed HYLE-native routes
one synchronous Completion observation after every node
for Graph, one complete fixed external-binding mask scan, one three-node plan walk, bounded two-input TensorView staging and one final already-terminal Completion construction

ownership_topology.candidate: One immutable shared Executable retains the three PreparedOperations; one exclusive pre-bound Invocation owns its Mem lifetime workspace and submits the fixed plan with caller-owned input, weight and output TensorViews
